name: synthesis-skills-writing
description: Writing, editing and publishing: reader briefings, articles and their refreshes, framing, checks for slop and bad-writing patterns, craft, fact-checking, link research, distribution, voice profiles, clean text and provenance, executive communication, disclosure decisions and a pre-deploy content gate. It builds on the core collection: Claude Code installs the core with it, and in Codex and Muse you install both. The core carries synthesis's guard, so every collection comes with it: the four hooks that hold sends, drafts and deploys for your approval and refuse destructive commands, and the runtime they run, with its board, approval codes and the rituals' records. Claude Code runs the hooks once installed; Codex and Muse once you approve them. The whole set, synthesis-skills, holds every skill in one plugin: https://github.com/synthesisengineering/synthesis-skills
